
// A consuming design selects two imported properties and assigns protobuf tags.
// Reference retains the importer's physical Go field identities; protobuf keeps
// its own wire namespace and does not inherit struct:field:name metadata.
var ProtoFields = Type("ProtoFields", func() {
	Reference(ImportedFields)
	Field(1, "type")
	Field(2, "type2")
})

var _ = Service("ProtoFields", func() {
	Method("Echo", func() {
		Payload(ProtoFields)
		Result(ProtoFields)
		GRPC(func() {
		})
	})
})
